description: This file contains functions for interacting with the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API, including URL normalization, error handling, voice ID validation, and the main TTS function that makes an HTTP POST request to generate speech audio.

methods.name: isValidVoiceId
methods.description: Validates if a given voice ID string matches the expected pattern of 10 to 40 alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes the base URL for ElevenLabs API, trimming trailing slashes or returning default URL if input is undefined.

methods.name: formatElevenLabsErrorPayload
methods.description: Formats error payload from ElevenLabs API into a readable string, extracting message and code.

methods.name: extractElevenLabsErrorDetail
methods.description: Reads and parses the response body to extract detailed error information from ElevenLabs API responses.

methods.name: assertElevenLabsVoiceSettings
methods.description: Validates voice settings parameters to ensure they are within acceptable ranges.

methods.name: elevenLabsTTS
methods.description: Main function to perform text-to-speech conversion via ElevenLabs API, handling URL construction, request, response, and error processing.
